MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[r:OWNS|LEADS|MEMBER_OF]->(x) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN type(r) AS rel, labels(x)[0] AS label, coalesce(x.name, x.id) AS item, r.valid_at AS since, null AS until, r.source_ids AS src, null AS closed_by UNION MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[h:WAS]->(x) WHERE h.predicate IN ['OWNS', 'LEADS', 'MEMBER_OF'] AND h.valid_at <= $t AND (h.invalid_at > $t OR h.closed_by IN $ended) RETURN h.predicate AS rel, labels(x)[0] AS label, coalesce(x.name, x.id) AS item, h.valid_at AS since, h.invalid_at AS until, h.source_ids AS src, h.closed_by AS closed_by
MATCH (:Decision)-[sup:SUPERSEDES]->(d:Decision) WHERE sup.valid_at <= $t RETURN collect(DISTINCT d.id)

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[mine:DECIDED]->(d:Decision) WHERE mine.valid_at <= $t AND NOT d.id IN $replaced MATCH (x)-[r:DECIDED|CONSTRAINS|SUPERSEDES]-(d) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t UNWIND r.source_ids AS sid MATCH (e:Episode {id: sid}) WHERE e.ts <= $t RETURN d.id, d.title, collect(DISTINCT e.author), collect(DISTINCT e.id) ORDER BY d.id

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[w:OWNS|WORKED_ON|WAS]->(s:System) WHERE w.valid_at <= $t AND (type(w) <> 'WAS' OR (w.predicate = 'OWNS' AND (w.invalid_at > $t OR w.closed_by IN $ended))) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN type(w) = 'WAS' THEN 'OWNS' ELSE type(w) END) AS rels MATCH (s)-[r:OWNS|WORKED_ON|DEPENDS_ON|CONSTRAINS|WAS]-(x) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t AND (type(r) <> 'WAS' OR r.invalid_at > $t OR r.closed_by IN $ended) UNWIND r.source_ids AS sid MATCH (e:Episode {id: sid}) WHERE e.ts <= $t RETURN s.name, s.kind, rels, collect(DISTINCT e.author), collect(DISTINCT e.id) ORDER BY s.name

UNWIND $items AS item MATCH (x:System {name: item}) OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(down:System) OPTIONAL MATCH (up:System)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(x) RETURN item, collect(DISTINCT down.name), collect(DISTINCT up.name)
UNWIND $items AS item MATCH (:Decision {id: item})-[:CONSTRAINS]->(s:System) RETURN item, collect(s.name)

UNWIND $systems AS sys MATCH (c:Person)-[w:WORKED_ON]->(:System {name: sys}) WHERE c.name <> $person OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN sys, c.name, t.name, coalesce(w.count, size(w.source_ids)), w.source_ids
MATCH (p:Person {name: $person}) RETURN p.notice_at, p.last_day, p.notice_source
MATCH (g:GateDecision) WHERE g.outcome = 'CLOSE' AND g.subject = $person OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:CITES]->(e:Episode) RETURN g.id, g.ts, g.predicate, g.object, collect(e.id) ORDER BY g.ts, g.id

MATCH (n:Person) RETURN 'Person' AS label, n.name AS key UNION ALL MATCH (n:Team) RETURN 'Team' AS label, n.name AS key UNION ALL MATCH (n:System) RETURN 'System' AS label, n.name AS key UNION ALL MATCH (n:Decision) RETURN 'Decision' AS label, n.id AS key

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:OWNS|WORKED_ON|MEMBER_OF|LEADS|DECIDED]->(x) RETURN 'Person' AS a_label, p.name AS a, labels(x)[0] AS b_label, coalesce(x.name, x.id) AS b, type(r) AS rel UNION ALL MATCH (d:Decision)-[r:CONSTRAINS]->(s:System) RETURN 'Decision' AS a_label, d.id AS a, 'System' AS b_label, s.name AS b, type(r) AS rel

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[r:OWNS|WORKED_ON|MEMBER_OF|LEADS|DECIDED]->(x) RETURN type(r) AS rel, labels(x)[0] AS label, coalesce(x.name, x.id) AS item, r.source_ids AS src, coalesce(r.count, 0) AS n, 'current' AS state UNION ALL MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[h:WAS]->(x) WHERE h.closed_by IN $ended RETURN h.predicate AS rel, labels(x)[0] AS label, coalesce(x.name, x.id) AS item, h.source_ids AS src, 0 AS n, 'ended' AS state
UNWIND $keys AS k CREATE (:Person {key: k})
UNWIND $keys AS k CREATE (:Team {key: k})
UNWIND $keys AS k CREATE (:System {key: k})
UNWIND $keys AS k CREATE (:Decision {key: k})
UNWIND $pairs AS e MATCH (a:Decision {key: e[0]}), (b:Person {key: e[1]}) CREATE (a)-[:LINK]->(b)
UNWIND $pairs AS e MATCH (a:Decision {key: e[0]}), (b:System {key: e[1]}) CREATE (a)-[:LINK]->(b)
UNWIND $pairs AS e MATCH (a:Person {key: e[0]}), (b:System {key: e[1]}) CREATE (a)-[:LINK]->(b)
UNWIND $pairs AS e MATCH (a:Person {key: e[0]}), (b:Team {key: e[1]}) CREATE (a)-[:LINK]->(b)

MATCH (:Decision)-[sup:SUPERSEDES]->(d:Decision) WHERE sup.valid_at <= $t RETURN collect(DISTINCT d.id)

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[dec:DECIDED]->(d:Decision)-[c:CONSTRAINS]->(x:System) WHERE dec.valid_at <= $t AND c.valid_at <= $t AND NOT d.id IN $replaced MATCH up = (s:System)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..0]->(x) RETURN d.id, x.name, s.name, length(up), [n IN nodes(up) | n.name], [r IN relationships(up) | r.valid_at], [r IN relationships(up) | r.source_ids], dec.source_ids + c.source_ids

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[h:OWNS|WAS]->(x:System) WHERE h.valid_at <= $t AND (type(h) = 'OWNS' OR (h.predicate = 'OWNS' AND (h.invalid_at > $t OR h.closed_by IN $ended))) MATCH up = (s:System)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..1]->(x) RETURN null, x.name, s.name, length(up), [n IN nodes(up) | n.name], [r IN relationships(up) | r.valid_at], [r IN relationships(up) | r.source_ids], h.source_ids

UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person)-[r:OWNS]->(:System {name: n}) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN n AS system, p.name AS owner, r.source_ids AS src UNION UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person)-[r:WAS]->(:System {name: n}) WHERE r.predicate = 'OWNS' AND r.valid_at <= $t AND r.invalid_at > $t RETURN n AS system, p.name AS owner, r.source_ids AS src

UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person {name: n})-[r:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN n AS person, t.name AS team UNION UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person {name: n})-[r:WAS]->(t:Team) WHERE r.predicate = 'MEMBER_OF' AND r.valid_at <= $t AND (r.invalid_at > $t OR r.closed_by IN $ended) RETURN n AS person, t.name AS team
UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (p:Person)-[r:DECIDED]->(:Decision {id: i}) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN i, collect(p.name)
UNWIND $items AS item MATCH (:Decision {id: item})-[:CONSTRAINS]->(s:System) RETURN item, collect(s.name)

UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person)-[r:OWNS]->(:System {name: n}) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN n AS system, p.name AS owner, r.source_ids AS src UNION UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person)-[r:WAS]->(:System {name: n}) WHERE r.predicate = 'OWNS' AND r.valid_at <= $t AND r.invalid_at > $t RETURN n AS system, p.name AS owner, r.source_ids AS src

UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person {name: n})-[r:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t RETURN n AS person, t.name AS team UNION UNWIND $names AS n MATCH (p:Person {name: n})-[r:WAS]->(t:Team) WHERE r.predicate = 'MEMBER_OF' AND r.valid_at <= $t AND (r.invalid_at > $t OR r.closed_by IN $ended) RETURN n AS person, t.name AS team
MATCH (:Decision)-[sup:SUPERSEDES]->(d:Decision) WHERE sup.valid_at <= $t RETURN collect(DISTINCT d.id)

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[mine:DECIDED]->(d:Decision) WHERE mine.valid_at <= $t AND NOT d.id IN $replaced MATCH (x)-[r:DECIDED|CONSTRAINS|SUPERSEDES]-(d) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t UNWIND r.source_ids AS sid MATCH (e:Episode {id: sid}) WHERE e.ts <= $t RETURN d.id, d.title, collect(DISTINCT e.author), collect(DISTINCT e.id) ORDER BY d.id

MATCH (me:Person {name: $person})-[w:OWNS|WORKED_ON|WAS]->(s:System) WHERE w.valid_at <= $t AND (type(w) <> 'WAS' OR (w.predicate = 'OWNS' AND (w.invalid_at > $t OR w.closed_by IN $ended))) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN type(w) = 'WAS' THEN 'OWNS' ELSE type(w) END) AS rels MATCH (s)-[r:OWNS|WORKED_ON|DEPENDS_ON|CONSTRAINS|WAS]-(x) WHERE r.valid_at <= $t AND (type(r) <> 'WAS' OR r.invalid_at > $t OR r.closed_by IN $ended) UNWIND r.source_ids AS sid MATCH (e:Episode {id: sid}) WHERE e.ts <= $t RETURN s.name, s.kind, rels, collect(DISTINCT e.author), collect(DISTINCT e.id) ORDER BY s.name
UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (e:Episode {id: i}) RETURN e.id, e.author, e.ts

MATCH (e:Episode) WHERE e.ts > $since AND e.author = $person RETURN e.id AS id, e.ts AS ts, e.channel AS channel, e.author AS author, e.title AS title, e.text AS text UNION MATCH (e:Episode)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Person {name: $person}) WHERE e.ts > $since RETURN e.id AS id, e.ts AS ts, e.channel AS channel, e.author AS author, e.title AS title, e.text AS text
MATCH (s:System) WHERE s.name IN $names AND s.kind = 'integration' RETURN s.name ORDER BY s.name
UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (e:Episode {id: i}) RETURN e.id, e.title, e.ts, e.channel, e.author
